title: After washing the black boarder is wrinkled! Not smooth
text:
After washing the black boarder is wrinkled! Not smooth. When I received these two king size pillow cases ,
Before washing they where smooth and looked good out of the package.
Then I washed them, put in the dryer with a dryer sheet.
Out of the dryer at the end of the cases where the black boarder is
There all wrinkled up, not smooth, there puckered.
These cases are not any type of 800 count cotton I have ever had!

I also wonder was the cotton heavily sprayed, as allot of cotton is?
Not as smooth as I expected, although I will use these and hopefully
Over time they will smooth out!
